items.title: Hook installer for Claude/Codex/Gemini configs and Pi extension (plan/apply/status)
items.rationale: Solid core (format-preserving JSON edit, preview plan, atomic write, symlink-safe, refuses invalid JSON, only removes groups whose every command is ours). Must change ownership markers for identity isolation (F0:10, 13.2:21, 16:26): hook commands key on TERAX_CLI (agent.rs:278-285, 333), Gemini name "terax" (agent.rs:318), Pi file terax-notifications.ts (agent.rs:135-136) and LEGACY_MARKERS (agent.rs:255) would make lut adopt/remove Terax's hooks. Selective uninstall per agent exists (AGT-007, F5:2, 13.2:15, 16:20); the Windows __terax_notify CONOUT$ path (agent.rs:638-665) is Terax-legacy and should go.
couplings: backend-core: src-tauri/src/lib.rs:169-180 (__terax_notify argv handler), lib.rs:397-401 (command registration)
items.risks: Dropping LEGACY_MARKERS and renaming the marker must be paired with tests proving Terax-owned groups survive lut install/uninstall. A lut dev build that already installed TERAX_CLI hooks would leave them behind (acceptable: no users yet, F0:10).

items.title: Loopback TCP control server, descriptor file, per-pane credentials, CLI launcher dir
items.rationale: Keep the design (127.0.0.1:0, 256-bit tokens, per-pane token bound to pty id, constant-time compare, replay ids), which satisfies 9.2. Identity isolation (F0:10): descriptor path dirs::cache_dir()/terax/control.json (control.rs:755-768) is shared with an installed Terax and overwritten by whichever app starts last; launcher dir terax/run/<pid>/bin/terax(.exe) (control.rs:910-943) and bundled binary name terax-cli (control.rs:805-829) must become lut-specific.
items.risks: The descriptor collision is silent: a CLI outside a pane talks to whichever app started last.

items.title: Hook request handling, normalization dispatch, rate limiter, decision broker
items.rationale: Validates pane/pty ownership (agent_events.rs:425-437), rate-limits droppable kinds (100 burst, 50/s, agent_events.rs:29-31), emits terax:agent-event to the owning window only and the legacy terax:agent-signal; the decision broker only waits when a window announced readiness and falls back to the agent's own prompt on ui-gone/pane-closed/timeout (9.8:4, 13.5:1, 14.1:8). Event names are app-internal Tauri events (rename on touch only).

items.title: terax-control-protocol crate: wire types, hook normalization per agent, payload trimming, decision rendering
items.rationale: This is the AgentAdapter of 9.5/AGT-012 in Rust: normalize(agent,event,payload) -> HookFacts (adapt.rs:86) with size limits (mod.rs:15-28, trim.rs:42). Keep logic; only user-visible strings ("Denied in Terax", render.rs:46) need visual rebranding. Crate name is internal (rename on touch).
items.risks: Event schemas per CLI version must be re-verified against official docs before enabling more events (9.4, 9.5).

items.title: terax-cli sidecar (open/ping/capabilities/identify/hook) and its build script
items.rationale: Identity isolation (F0:10): reads TERAX_PANE_ID/TERAX_CONTROL_ADDR/TERAX_CONTROL_TOKEN/TERAX_HOOK_* (hook.rs:55-69, lib.rs:107,285-286) and falls back to cache/terax/control.json (lib.rs:300); binary name terax-cli (Cargo.toml:13, build-cli.mjs:59-81, TERAX_CLI_TARGET env at build-cli.mjs:50). Rename env vars, descriptor dir and output binary to lut equivalents; help text is visual rebranding.
couplings: backend-core: src-tauri/src/modules/pty/scripts/profile.ps1:9-11, zshrc.zsh:26, init.fish:17 (`terax` shell function wrapping $TERAX_CLI)
items.risks: externalBin name, build script output and find_bundled_cli must change in the same PR.

items.title: Normalized agent model: types, reducer, attention ordering
items.rationale: Pure, well-tested reducer over hook/signal events with states starting/working/needs-input/needs-approval/... and provenance process|osc|hook (types.ts:1-23), matching 9.3/9.5/AGT-005/AGT-012. Not wired to any UI today (reduceAgents only referenced from tests). Wiring is new work (F5:1) tracked under agents/notifications-bridge.

items.title: agentStore: simplified CLI sessions + localAgent + notification list
items.rationale: Mixes localAgent (AI agent) with CLI sessions and notifications (agentStore.ts:13-26); F2:5 and 9.9:3 require splitting before removing AI. Long term superseded by the reducer-backed store (F5:1).

items.title: Managed (AI-supervised) Claude agents and auto-review rounds
items.rationale: Only exists for Terax's built-in AI agent supervising Claude (review.ts:1,30-38 import ai chatStore/chatRuntime). lut drops the own AI agent; CLI agents must work without API keys (AGT-003, 13.2:17, F2:gate).
items.risks: Must be removed together with or after the ai code that imports it.

items.title: Notification routing logic: delivery decision, dedupe gate, OS notification, sound, focus tracking, display names
items.rationale: Logic is reusable for AGT-006 (focus action via onActivate, route.ts:24) but preferences are only two booleans (agentNotifications/agentNotificationSound, route.ts:43,58); AGT-010 requires per-kind types, sound choice and privacy (14.2). route.ts:3 imports showAgentToast (visual). Strings "Terax notifications are working" (notify.ts:40) and display name terax (format.ts:8) are visual rebranding.
items.risks: notification.mp3 provenance/licence should be checked if kept.

items.title: Agent launcher catalogue and command validation
items.rationale: Pure data/validation (launcher.ts:3-40 catalogue, control-char/length checks). The silent hook install lives in the caller (App.tsx:636) and is handled by agents-D04.

items.title: Agent UI components: launcher panel, notification bell, toast, agent icons, module barrel
items.rationale: Purely visual Terax components; lut UI is designed by the user. Logic to salvage: hook status refresh and one-click install (NotificationBell.tsx:200-229, replaced by a consented preview flow, AGT-007), badge counting (NotificationBell.tsx:190-197), launch command persistence (AgentLauncherPanel.tsx:55-61). agentIcon has a terax -> /logo.png special case (agentIcon.tsx:54).

items.title: AgentNotificationsBridge: simplified signal -> agentStore -> notification path
items.rationale: Renders nothing; consumes only terax:agent-signal (started/working/attention/finished/exited) and maps finished to 'waiting' (AgentNotificationsBridge.tsx:65-93), ignoring the detailed hook model. F5:1/AGT-012/9.5 require a non-visual service driven by reduceAgents + connectAgentEvents, with Stop treated as response-done, not exit (9.3).
items.risks: Pane correlation via leafIdForPty must stay correct for panes sharing cwd (16:17).

items.title: Frontend control-module adapters: hook event parsing, terminal notifications, hooks config IPC
items.rationale: Validates native payloads (parseAgentHookEvent, agentEvents.ts:88) and maps them to model events; hooksConfig.ts already exposes plan/apply for a preview UI (AGT-007). Not yet consumed (control/agents.ts is not imported by app code). Event-name constants are internal.

items.title: Frontend permission-decision client (agent_decisions_ready / agent_decision_respond)
items.rationale: UI approvals are P2 and out of the initial MVP (AGT-011, 9.8). Code is unused and harmless (agents only wait if a window announces readiness). Decide when AGT-011 is scheduled.
items.risks: If enabled without the 9.8 guarantees, agents could block up to MAX_DECISION_SECS (900s).

items.title: useControlBridge: answers CLI open/identify requests forwarded by the control server
items.rationale: Logic (caller pane -> tab/space context, readiness queue, open-file in editor) is useful for the `lut <file>` CLI; it depends on Tabs/Spaces and the editor, so it must follow their refactors. User-visible string "Terax could not create an editor tab" (useControlBridge.ts:140) is rebranding.
items.risks: If the editor is removed (ide-tools), the `open` method must degrade or be removed from METHODS.

notes: Cross-area: (1) backend-core shell_init.rs:195-226 injects TERAX_TERMINAL/TERAX_CONTROL_ADDR/TERAX_CONTROL_TOKEN/TERAX_PANE_ID/TERAX_CLI and prepends the launcher bin dir to PATH; the env rename must land in the same PR as the CLI rename (agents-D01). (2) backend-core lib.rs:169-180 handles argv `__terax_notify` (legacy Windows hook path); remove with agents-D02. (3) build-identity tauri.conf.json:38-39 externalBin binaries/terax-cli + package.json build:cli. (4) ai: managed agents/review and LocalAgentNotificationsBridge depend on this area; useAiLiveBridge.ts:131 installs Claude hooks silently. (5) app-shell App.tsx:636-645 installs hooks silently when launching an agent; NotificationBell installs with one click without preview. (6) state-settings owns agentNotifications/agentNotificationSound/agentLaunchCommands keys.
